summary: The monitors on the main deck suddenly activate, causing Trinity to scream. Tank and Morpheus exchange a look, recognizing the moment as a miracle. Trinity commands Neo to get up.

what_changes.after: Screaming as the monitors jump back to life
what_changes.evidence: Trinity screams as the monitors jump back to life.
Tank and Morpheus look at each other. It is a miracle.

event_hint.one_line: Neo's vital signs return on the monitors.
